Name: Purple craftables (Content Patcher)
Author: leonaryquinoy
Description:
Turns craftables like the loom, tapper and keg into purple ones. Did this mostly for my own aesthetic to go with the lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/420]Witchy-Gothic buildings[/url], but figured I might as well share in case anyone else enjoys this. 

There is an optional version where wool from your sheep and on on the loom, as well as the cloth, are replaced with black instead of white, if you use something like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/153]Black Sheep and Void Sheep replacer[/url] or another mod that gives you black sheep. Or if you just want black wool and cloth for the hell of it.

If you have another mod that modifies the craftables.xnb this might interfere with it. This is also one of my first mods so there may very well be issues, but I'll work on them when I can.

Install as you would any content patcher mod.

Downloads.Description: Adds black wool from sheep and on looms, which turns to black cloth.
